messages.author: 7dd668eb41c5bfd9
messages.subject: upgrading to pystan 2.4 from 2.3
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to upgrade from pystan 2.3 to pystan 2.4 so that I can take advantage of the vectorized multivariate normal. I'm running OS X 10.9.4. I install via pip install pystan, and it seems to install OK. But when I load Python and import pystan, it imports the old 2.3.0 version that I was running.

Is there a way to uninstall 2.3 or to force Python to load 2.4?

Thanks!

Nate

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] upgrading to pystan 2.4 from 2.3
parts:
That's an interesting error. ``pip`` should know about the old version and get
rid of it. In fact, it should overwrite the old installation. Did you install
2.3.0 with ``pip`` or some other way?

Best,

-a
